QuestInfo.name: The Door to Elsewhere
QuestInfo.1:
#b#p9390354##k found that there were three places #bTristan's Sword#k might be located...
But the monsters ate the keys. Get as many Key Fragments as possible at the First Door, and piece them together. 
#b#p9390353##k says the monsters are near there.
Use the first key fragments you've collected from your inventory.
#b#p9390353##k will be waiting for you by the entrance.
QuestInfo.2: You didn't find anything at the first location.\r\n

0.0: This is the information #b#p9390354##k got. There are three places where the sword might be buried over by Another Door.
0.1: But, we don't know which one is the spot... And the monsters ate up the keys.
0.2: Let's start with the first location. Hunt #bWild Kargos#k near the #bTemple Entrance#k and you'll get #bTristan's First Key Fragments#k. Collect enough to piece the key together.

0.msg: Get as many Key Fragments as you can. The more, the better.

2.msg: You seriously don't know how to use items at your level?! Fine, fine. The key fragments should be in the Use tab of your inventory. Double-click on them to use them. You should collect as many as you can for better shot at finishing the key.

3.msg: Head to the #bTemple Entrance#k when the key's finished, and talk to Canary.

yes.0: You found the key. Give it to me! Let's try it here!\r\n
yes.2: Oh well. All this baggage is wearing me out... When are we heading out for the next door?

item.0: Get more Key Fragments to piece together!
